affine.description: Community AFFiNE MCP server (DAWNCR0W/affine-mcp-server) for the self-hosted instance on Akana; it can create and edit documents and Organize folders, which the built-in endpoint cannot. Signs in with e-mail and password: use a dedicated least-privilege AFFiNE account that is a member of the target workspace only, and put AFFINE_URL, AFFINE_EMAIL, AFFINE_PASSWORD and AFFINE_WORKSPACE_ID in .env. The full profile is needed because the authoring profile has no Organize folder tools. The destructive group is disabled (deletes, replace_doc_with_markdown, publish_doc and revoke_doc), and workspace, profile and settings changes are turned off by name; trash_doc and restore_doc stay available. AFFINE_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP is needed because the instance has no TLS; use on LAN and Tailscale only. Writes go through CRDT updates: try on a test workspace first.
